items.q: Will servicing here void my warranty?
items.a: No. We follow the manufacturer's schedule and parts spec, and stamp your service book. Keep the receipt with it.

items.q: What if you find something else wrong?
items.a: You get photos and a price on WhatsApp first. We only do it if you say yes — no surprise bills.
Yes. We fit to JPJ light-transmission limits — at least 70% on the windscreen, 50% on the front side windows, 30% at the rear — and give you the film card.

items.q: Can you handle my insurance claim?
items.a: Tell us on WhatsApp what happened. We'll say honestly whether it's worth claiming, and what your insurer will need.

items.q: Can I wait while you work?
items.a: For a minor service, yes — about an hour in the lounge with Wi-Fi and drinks. Longer jobs, add pickup & drop-off.
